lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima distributed in vertical columns across the central and posterior flank, with diameter variations ranging from ~10 to ~30 pixels.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance values intersect the primary blob centroids, forming a repeating grid pattern characteristic of the mid-lateral flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible in the upper third of the flank, manifesting as linear features with high-luminance upper edges and lower-luminance (shadowed) ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin (lower right quadrant) exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots that are significantly reduced in diameter compared to the primary flank constellation.
